subject: Recurrent Neural Network
source_sentence: The system extracts features from the sentence which are processed by a form of recurrent neural network called BDLSTM to create a set of AMR concepts.
title: Abstract

subject: greedy algorithm
source_sentence: All concepts are then connected using an iterative, greedy algorithm to compute the set of relations in the AMR.
